blocks.text: CITY OF BALIWAG — Water buckets, drums, and other branded containers have been flying off the shelves for more than a week now as residents deal with ongoing water service interruptions in many Bulacan towns and the “Super El Niño.” At Imelda Drum Trading along Maharlika Highway in Barangay Tarcan in Baliwag City, average daily sales of P2,000 to P5,000 have doubled, according to Edna Sabido, the store manager’s wife. Bulacan motorists bound for Nueva Ecija and Metro Manila or headed home have stopped at her store to scoop up a bucket or two. READ: El Niño affects over 451,000 people […]...
